schemes.name: Standard 2-Byte Node ID + Device Type + TLV
schemes.description: Standard Header: 2-Byte Node ID (bytes 0..1), 1-Byte Device Type (Class/Capability, byte 2), 1-Byte Seq (byte 3), followed by dynamic TLV sensors
schemes.matchCondition:
// Match standard 4+ byte header
return bytes.length >= 4;

schemes.name: Cayenne LPP Standard Sensors
schemes.description: Decodes standard IPSO/Cayenne LPP sensors (temp, hum, analog, GPS)
schemes.matchCondition:
// Match Cayenne LPP channels
return bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[1] === 0x67 || bytes[1] === 0x68 || bytes[1] === 0x02 || bytes[1] === 0x01);
